phrases.text: A little coral break! Back in {minutes} minutes.
I'm back! Did you miss me?
Being a potted plant in the coral for {minutes} minutes. Remember me!
Borrowing the coral lounge for {minutes} minutes. Brought my own leaf cushion!
Asking the coral for growing tips. Back in {minutes} minutes!
A {minutes}-minute game of hide-and-seek! You already know the answer.
Giving my leaves a {minutes}-minute holiday!
The coral invited me for tea. Back in {minutes} minutes!
Joining the coral choir for a {minutes}-minute rehearsal!
Pretending to be seaweed for {minutes} minutes. Wish me luck!
A tiny {minutes}-minute holiday, then back to keeping you company.
Waiting behind the coral for inspiration. Giving it {minutes} minutes!
I'm back! The coral complimented my leaves.
Hide-and-seek is over! You win. You saw me the whole time.
The coral's growing advice? Take your time.
Brought back a little sea breeze. Half is yours!
Tea is over! The cups were tiny seashells.
Tried to be seaweed. My leaves started giggling.
All rested! Even my leaves have perked up.
The coral said to visit again. I said you were waiting.
No inspiration, but I did meet some lovely bubbles.
The choir turned me down. Too much rustling, apparently.
